rows.grounds: instrumental plural of compound ṣaṣ-bīja, indicating the means of placement
adjective agreeing with ṣaḍbījaiḥ, specifying the initial six
ritual placement of mantra elements on the body
demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously described mantra

items.question: What constitutes the six-limbed placement prescribed for this mantra?
premises: The placement is performed with six seed-syllables.
These six seed-syllables are specified as the first ones.
The placement of this mantra is declared to be six-limbed.
items.inference: Therefore, the six-limbed placement of this mantra is accomplished using the first six seed-syllables.
uncertainties: The referent of asya depends on the preceding verses describing the mantra.
items.plain_english: The six-limbed placement of this mantra is proclaimed to be performed with the first six seed-syllables.
